comments_text: H. petersii (Hp) peptides were derived from a non-amplified cDNA library. Activity: Active against herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1, EC50=0.43 uM)). It also showed activity against intracellular herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) ( Hong et al., 2014). Updated 11/2023
title: Inhibitory activity and mechanism of two scorpion venom peptides against herpes simplex virus type 1.

comments_text: H. petersii (Hp) peptides were derived from a non-amplified cDNA library. Activity: Active against herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1, EC50=0.41 uM). It also showed activity against intracellular herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) ( Hong et al., 2014). Updated 11/2023
title: Inhibitory activity and mechanism of two scorpion venom peptides against herpes simplex virus type 1.

comments_text: Function: Amphipathic peptide with antibacterial activities (By similarity). Shows antiviral activities against the herpes simplex virus type-1. It potently inhibits the initial infection by provoking the rupture of viral envelop and the dissociation of proteins from the virions (EC (50) is 0.41 ??M). It also effectively inhibits viral attachment (EC (50) is 5.73 ??M), viral entry (EC (50) is 4.32 ??M) and viral proliferation after infection (EC (50) is 8.41 ??M). Morever, it enters mammalian tested cells (Vero) and reduces the intracellular infectivity.
